+ // Types

+   apiSecret: string;
+   baseUrl?: string;
+ }

+ export interface CaptureOptions {

+     width?: number;
+     height?: number;
+   };
+   fullPage?: boolean;
+   quality?: number;
+ }
+ 
+ export type CaptureType = 'image' | 'pdf' | 'content' | 'metadata';
+ 
+ export interface CaptureResult<T = unknown> {
+   success: boolean;

+ // Constants
+ const DEFAULT_BASE_URL = 'https://cdn.capture.page';
+ const DEFAULT_DELAY = 1;
+ 
+ // Helper functions
+ const generateHash = (url: string, apiSecret: string): string => {
+   return createHash('md5')
+     .update(`${url}${apiSecret}`)
+     .digest('hex');
+ };
+ 
+ const buildCaptureUrl = (
+   config: CaptureServiceConfig,

+   // Build query parameters

+   if (options?.quality !== undefined) {
+     queryParams.append('quality', String(options.quality));
+   }
+   
+   return `${baseUrl}/${config.apiKey}/${hash}/${type}?${queryParams.toString()}`;
+ };
